company.name: Finley Technologies
company.shortDescription: Finley helps companies streamline debt capital raise and management.
company.description: Finley simplifies debt capital raise and management. Finley's software helps growing companies automate due diligence, ensure compliance, and streamline ongoing reporting with their capital providers. Customers like Ramp rely on Finley to manage hundreds of millions in debt capital from capital providers. The Finley team brings experience from Goldman Sachs, Nova Credit, and Palantir Technologies, and is backed by Y Combinator and Bain Capital Ventures.

productsAndServices.description: Software that automates, tracks, and manages debt capital operations including funding, verification, and analysis for borrowers, issuers, credit funds, and banks.
